# Bootstrap

<!-- Generated by `prism docs` from `src/Bootstrap.pr`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Bootstrap checker workbench.

The Rust compiler exports the authoritative artifacts. This module decodes their declaration, resolved-tree, and rich surface views, checks the pure first-order subset with `Tc`, and uses `Data.Diff` to report the first fact that diverges. Unsupported forms are coverage, never disagreements.
